bat-straps._why: BAT+ from BT1.1 round the battery on B.Cu. Same path as v2 up to the diagonal, then y 104.0 (was 103.08) so a signal can hop from B.Cu to F.Cu between the F.Cu power wall and the strap; two 0.8/0.4 vias into R8.1 (PWR-52, one before). BAT- return is on In2, see planes.

pwr-charger._why: BQ25628 cluster, Q1/Q2 and +5V: copied from v3 (= v2 layout, charger and BMS bring-up done on it).

pwr-gauge._why: BQ27742 cluster: copied from v3. The 0.25/0.15 via at U3.C2 is the only way out of that ball; its hole clearance to D2, D3, C3 is known and unchanged.

pwr-dcdc._why: TPS63802 and LM66200: copied from v3. L1/L2 are now short 0.45 mm tracks: the old 0.25 mm tracks carried the inductor current, their zones sat inside the L2 keepout (PWR-20).

gnd-power._why: GND and +3.3V vias around the power stages, the U4 pad and the USB shield, copied from v3: the autorouter only fans out one via per pad.

usb._why: USB input, ESD-side parts and the D+/D- pair on B.Cu over the In2 GND island: copied from v3.

nand-spi._why: NAND SCLK, MISO, NAND CS and the east MOSI branch: copied from v3 (10 MHz nets, short, on F/B).

gnss-lp5036._why: GNSS RF feed and backup supply, LP5036 local parts: copied from v3.

booster._why: ePaper booster: copied from v3. GDR and RESE keep their ends and run on In2 below the FPC via row.

epaper-lanes._why: R-V3-10 and the return-path review: SCLK runs R63 to the FPC on F.Cu over solid In1 GND, no via until the FPC hop. MOSI, D/C, CS, BUSY beside it through the left rail at 0.15/0.15 (52 ohm). D/C, CS and BUSY drop to B.Cu south of C78; the rest of those three is autorouted. U5-TS, U3-TS and REG25 stay on B.Cu so they do not cross the lanes on the way to the NTCs.

gauge-i2c._why: U3 SDA and SCL leave the ball field on In2 (as v3) and land south of the BAT+ strap; autorouted on from there.

rail-right._why: RX and TX as on v3 (F.Cu right rail, under U18). I2C to U20 and on through the neck on In2 to CN2, U5 to U15 on In2, tab to U12: v3 paths, no In1. ePaper RES is new: F.Cu south of the BT1 NPTH to the FPC hop.

u5-escapes._why: U5 pins behind the F.Cu power wall. QON crosses the BAT+ strap through the F.Cu gap between REGN and C22. CHG_INT cannot get south on F or B (TS, TS_BIAS and the SYS and Pack+ pours), so it runs on In2 beside SDA and SCL, as v3 did on B.Cu round the west end before the NTC lanes took that way. U5-TS keeps its v3 ties and reaches the NTC lane on F.Cu along the battery cut-out.

plane-bridges._why: The In2 lanes and the FPC via row fill the whole neck, so the +3.3V plane comes through in three pieces: top left (LED1, LED2, CN2, R39, R40), FPC1, and the rest. A 0.2 mm B.Cu link north of the FPC pads and a 0.15 mm B.Cu link south of the cap vias join them (the v3 board needed the same, group p31-bridge).

led-in2._why: LED1 and LED2 from U20: the neck has no room on F/B beside the FPC rows, so all six run on In2 (LED2 was on In1, which now carries no signal). Slow PWM lines, 0.15 mm at 0.28 pitch, In1 GND is their reference.

plane-fabric._why: GND and +3.3V vias with their stubs, copied from v3 except where the new lanes need the spot. The autorouter gets no pins on these two nets; vias reach In1 and In2 directly.
